text: The Curry-Howard correspondent of the fan theorem (in Brouwer's intuitionism) is:
choices: the continuity of all functions ℕᴺ→ℕ is equivalent to well-foundedness of bar types
explanation: The fan theorem (Brouwer) states that any bar on the universal spread is a uniform bar. Its computational content is: every function ℕᴺ→ℕ is continuous (uses only finite initial segments of its argument).
